content: {"paper_id":"W2604553154","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"Partial label learning aims to induce a multi-class classifier from training examples where each of them is associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one label is valid.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确以偏标记学习为研究任务，每个训练实例给出候选标签集且其中仅一个为真标签，符合偏标记学习定义。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"each of them is associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one label is valid","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"以候选标签集替代唯一真值的监督条件作为核心学习问题，符合弱监督学习定义中候选歧义这一不完整或不精确监督形式。"},{"keyword_id":"classifier-ensemble","exact_quote":"a boosting-style partial label learning approach is proposed to enabling confidence-rated discriminative modeling","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"采用boosting式方法逐轮训练基分类器，属于结合多个基分类器完成分类的集成方法。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
